rav-chananya.name: Rav Ḥananya
rav-chananya.bio: Babylonian Amora who objects to a derivation about the coatings of idols in Temurah 28b.
rav-chananya.prompt: A Babylonian scholar in his 40s with a dark beard and a searching expression, one finger raised as he presses a question; background of a mud-brick study hall with a single oil lamp.

rabbi-abba-bar-kahana.name: Rabbi Abba bar Kahana
rabbi-abba-bar-kahana.bio: Amora of the Land of Israel, known above all for his teachings of aggada.
rabbi-abba-bar-kahana.prompt: A sage in his 60s with a long silver beard and a warm storyteller’s expression, an open hand raised as he tells a story from Scripture; background of a Galilean study hall with stone arches at evening.
